description: Run your Cloudbeds property: find, book, change and cancel reservations, check availability, assign rooms, check guests in and out, manage guests and notes, set housekeeping status and record payments.

cloudbeds_guest_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a guest's details change, including when they check in or out. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.guest_id: The guest's ID, for the guest steps.
output.room_name: The room they're in, if one is assigned.

cloudbeds_guest_checked_in_trigger.description: Runs for each reservation that is checked in. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.reservation_id: The reservation's ID, for the reservation steps.
output.source_name: Where it was booked, such as Website or Booking.com.
output.status: Its status: not_confirmed, confirmed, checked_in, checked_out, canceled or no_show.

cloudbeds_guest_checked_out_trigger.description: Runs for each reservation that is checked out. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.reservation_id: The reservation's ID, for the reservation steps.
output.source_name: Where it was booked, such as Website or Booking.com.
output.status: Its status: not_confirmed, confirmed, checked_in, checked_out, canceled or no_show.

cloudbeds_new_guest_trigger.description: Runs for each new guest, whether made with a reservation or added to one. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.guest_id: The guest's ID, for the guest steps.
output.is_main_guest: Whether they're the reservation's main guest.

cloudbeds_new_reservation_trigger.description: Runs for each new reservation at the property, however it was booked. Reservations already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.reservation_id: The reservation's ID, for the reservation steps.
output.source_name: Where it was booked, such as Website or Booking.com.
output.status: Its status: not_confirmed, confirmed, checked_in, checked_out, canceled or no_show.

cloudbeds_reservation_canceled_trigger.description: Runs for each reservation that is canceled. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.reservation_id: The reservation's ID, for the reservation steps.
output.source_name: Where it was booked, such as Website or Booking.com.
output.status: Its status: not_confirmed, confirmed, checked_in, checked_out, canceled or no_show.

cloudbeds_reservation_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a reservation changes, such as its dates, rooms, guests or status, and when one is made. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.reservation_id: The reservation's ID, for the reservation steps.
output.source_name: Where it was booked, such as Website or Booking.com.
output.status: Its status: not_confirmed, confirmed, checked_in, checked_out, canceled or no_show.

cloudbeds_room_condition_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a room becomes clean or dirty, such as when housekeeping finishes it or a guest checks out. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.frontdesk_status: Today at the front desk: check-in, check-out, stayover, turnover or unused.
output.occupied: Whether a guest is in it.
output.room_condition: Its condition now: clean or dirty.
output.room_id: The room's ID, for the housekeeping and room steps.

parameters.description: Only rooms that become this: clean or dirty. Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: room_condition
